resources.string: Your privacy. Your standards. Your move.
See your device clearly — then choose to protect it
Know your device\'s risk in minutes — then protect what matters most.

You already protect your money, your passwords, and your reputation.
Why leave the phone that holds all three to chance?

CoreGuard helps you see what's going on — then act with confidence.

GET CLARITY IN MINUTES
Your Guardian Score turns complex device checks into one number you can understand: root heuristics, debugger signals, emulator clues, build integrity, spyware indicators, and certificate status.

CHECK AGAINST KNOWN SPYWARE INDICATORS
Nemesis Scanner compares your device with open-source privacy / spyware indicators sourced from the Amnesty International Security Lab (mvt-project) and related feeds. A clean result is reassuring — not a magic guarantee — and a flagged result gives you something concrete to act on.

TURN ON A PRIVACY SHIELD
Enable an on-device DNS-filtering VPN that can block domains matching known surveillance / tracker indicators. Allowed DNS queries still go to your system or upstream resolver. You stay in control; CoreGuard does not route all traffic through our servers.

MEASURE WHAT MATTERS
Review an educational MASVS-oriented scorecard and export a local JSON report for your notes or security review.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE COREGUARD
- Built for journalists, activists, and privacy-minded professionals
- Scans and reports stay on your device
- No ads. No selling your personal data
- Clear language, not fear theater

START NOW
Install CoreGuard, run your first check, and decide — with evidence — how you want to protect your digital life today.

CoreGuard is an independent project and is not affiliated with Amnesty International. Privacy signatures are sourced from the Amnesty International Security Lab / mvt-project.
